name: Current Affairs 2025–26
description: Recent events and appointments, verified as of August 2026. Refresh by editing this file.

questions.question: Who is the Chief Justice of India as of 2026?
questions.explanation: Justice Surya Kant took oath as the 53rd CJI on 24 November 2025 and serves till February 2027. He is the first CJI from Haryana.

questions.question: Who is the current Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (as of 2026)?
questions.explanation: Sanjay Malhotra, the 26th RBI Governor, took office on 11 December 2024 for a three-year term, succeeding Shaktikanta Das.

questions.question: Who took charge as Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission in May 2025?
questions.explanation: Dr. Ajay Kumar, a 1985-batch Kerala-cadre IAS officer and former Defence Secretary, became UPSC Chairman on 15 May 2025.

questions.question: Who chairs the 8th Central Pay Commission, constituted in October 2025?
questions.explanation: Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai chairs the 8th CPC — the first woman to head a pay commission. It must submit its report within 18 months.

questions.question: What did the Union Budget 2026–27 do with personal income-tax slabs and rates?
questions.explanation: The Budget 2026–27 kept slabs and rates unchanged and focused on simplification; the new Income Tax Act took effect from 1 April 2026.

questions.question: Budget 2026–27 reduced the TCS rate on foreign remittances for education, medical treatment and travel to what level?
questions.explanation: The TCS rate on these remittances was slashed to 2% to ease cash-flow stress for students, patients and travellers.

questions.question: India overtook which country in late 2025 to become the world's fourth-largest economy (GDP ~$4.18 trillion)?
questions.explanation: Per the government's year-end economic review (December 2025), India surpassed Japan and is projected to overtake Germany around 2028–30.

questions.question: India won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 by beating which team in the final at Ahmedabad?
questions.explanation: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs (255/5) on 8 March 2026 — a record third title and the first team to successfully defend the T20 crown.

questions.question: Who was named Player of the Tournament at the T20 World Cup 2026?
questions.explanation: Sanju Samson won the award after scoring 321 runs at a strike rate of ~199, including 89 in the final. Bumrah was Player of the Match.

questions.question: Who won the FIFA World Cup 2026, held in the USA, Canada and Mexico?
questions.explanation: Spain beat Argentina 1–0 after extra time (Ferran Torres, 106th minute) at MetLife Stadium on 19 July 2026 — Spain's second world title.

questions.question: The 2026 FIFA World Cup was the first edition to feature how many teams?
questions.explanation: The 2026 tournament was the first with 48 teams and the first co-hosted by three countries (USA, Canada, Mexico).

questions.question: India won the ICC Champions Trophy 2025 final by defeating New Zealand in which city?
questions.explanation: India won by 4 wickets in Dubai on 9 March 2025 — a record third Champions Trophy title, completed with an unbeaten run. Rohit Sharma was Player of the Match.

questions.question: Which two cities hosted the 2026 Winter Olympics?
options: Salt Lake City and Park City
questions.explanation: Milano Cortina 2026 (Feb 2026) saw Norway top the medal table with 18 golds; India's two athletes set personal milestones but won no medals.

questions.question: At the 2025 World Athletics Championships in Tokyo, who won the men's javelin gold, with India's Neeraj Chopra finishing eighth?
questions.explanation: Keshorn Walcott won gold (88.16 m). Sachin Yadav finished fourth for India with a personal best; Neeraj Chopra's best was 84.03 m.

questions.question: Which humanoid robot will fly aboard ISRO's first uncrewed Gaganyaan test mission (G1)?
questions.explanation: Vyommitra, a half-humanoid robot, will fly on the uncrewed G1 flight planned for 2026, ahead of India's first crewed Gaganyaan mission.

questions.question: What is the objective of ISRO's Chandrayaan-4 mission (targeted around 2028)?
options: Bring lunar samples back to Earth
questions.explanation: Chandrayaan-4 is a lunar sample-return mission aiming to bring soil/rock samples from near the Moon's south pole back to Earth.

questions.question: Chandrayaan-5 (LUPEX) is a joint lunar polar exploration mission between India and which country?
questions.explanation: LUPEX (Lunar Polar Exploration) is a joint ISRO–JAXA mission featuring a lander and rover to study water ice at the lunar south pole.

questions.question: Samudrayaan, India's first crewed deep-ocean mission planned for 2026, will use which submersible?
questions.explanation: NIOT's Matsya-6000 will carry three crew members to a depth of 6,000 m under the Deep Ocean Mission — a first for India.

questions.question: The PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (approved July 2025) covers how many low-productivity districts?
questions.explanation: It covers 100 low-productivity districts with an outlay of ₹24,000 crore per year for 6 years, converging 36 central schemes across 11 ministries.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Karnataka on 3 June 2026?
questions.explanation: D. K. Shivakumar became the 18th CM of Karnataka on 3 June 2026 after Siddaramaiah stepped down, completing a Congress power-sharing arrangement.

questions.question: How many Gazetted Probationer vacancies were announced in the KPSC KAS 2026 notification (released 31 July 2026)?
questions.explanation: The KPSC KAS 2026 notification announced 319 posts — 117 Group A and 202 Group B — with applications on kpsc.kar.nic.in.

questions.question: What was the size of the Karnataka Budget 2026–27 presented on 6 March 2026?
questions.explanation: CM Siddaramaiah presented a record ₹4,48,004 crore budget with a ₹22,957 crore revenue deficit, built around an '11G model' of growth.

questions.question: The Karnataka Budget 2026–27 announced the creation of how many teacher posts and the upgrade of how many schools?
questions.explanation: It announced 15,000 teaching posts and the upgradation of 800 government schools into 'Karnataka Public Schools', along with AI-assisted learning.

questions.question: Which social-media rule did Karnataka announce in its 2026–27 budget?
questions.explanation: Karnataka proposed banning social media for children below 16, alongside one-day-per-month paid menstrual leave for working women.

questions.question: Which country holds the G20 Presidency in 2026?
questions.explanation: South Africa held the 2025 presidency (Johannesburg summit); the United States holds it in 2026.

questions.question: ISRO's 100th launch mission (January 2025) used which rocket to place the navigation satellite NVS-02 in orbit?
questions.explanation: GSLV-F15 lifted off on 29 January 2025 from Sriharikota, marking ISRO's 100th launch-vehicle mission and carrying NVS-02 for the NavIC constellation.
